about: cym_for_kor step 1 (cs #764): Korean known-side seed drafts against Hadau Creiddiol North 1-668 (live: cym_nv2_for_eng S1001-S1668). DRAFT for Kai; nothing written to any course row.

seeds.welsh: dw i isio siarad Cymraeg efo chdi rŵan
seeds.english: I want to speak Welsh with you now
seeds.korean: 저는 지금 당신과 웨일스어로 이야기하고 싶어요
seeds.note: siarad = 이야기하다 throughout (deud = 말하다), so speak and say never share a Korean verb

seeds.welsh: dw i’n trio dysgu
seeds.english: I'm trying to learn
seeds.korean: 저는 배우려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: sut i siarad mor aml â phosib
seeds.english: how to speak as often as possible
seeds.korean: 가능한 한 자주 이야기하는 방법
seeds.note: fragment in Welsh and English; no 해요 ending possible

seeds.welsh: sut i ddeud rhywbeth yn y Gymraeg
seeds.english: how to say something in Welsh
seeds.korean: 웨일스어로 무언가를 말하는 방법

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mynd i ymarfer siarad efo rhywun arall
seeds.english: I'm going to practise speaking with someone else
seeds.korean: 저는 다른 사람과 이야기하는 연습을 할 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n trio cofio gair
seeds.english: I'm trying to remember a word
seeds.korean: 저는 단어 하나를 기억하려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dw i isio trio mor galed ag y medra i heddiw
seeds.english: I want to try as hard as I can today
seeds.korean: 저는 오늘 제가 할 수 있는 만큼 열심히 노력하고 싶어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mynd i drio esbonio be’ dw i’n ei olygu
seeds.english: I'm going to try to explain what I mean
seeds.korean: 저는 제 말이 무슨 뜻인지 설명하려고 노력할 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n siarad tipyn bach o Gymraeg rŵan
seeds.english: I speak a little Welsh now
seeds.korean: 저는 이제 웨일스어를 조금 해요
seeds.note: siarad + language with no partner = 웨일스어를 하다 (natural Korean); rŵan = 지금/이제

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn siŵr os medra i gofio’r frawddeg gyfan
seeds.english: I'm not sure if I can remember the whole sentence
seeds.korean: 저는 문장 전체를 기억할 수 있을지 확실하지 않아요
seeds.note: ddim yn siŵr = 확실하지 않아요, kept apart from ddim yn gwybod = 몰라요

seeds.welsh: liciwn i fedru siarad ar ôl i ti orffen
seeds.english: I'd like to be able to speak after you finish
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 끝낸 후에 이야기할 수 있으면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: fyddwn i ddim yn licio dyfalu be’ sy’n mynd i ddigwydd ’fory
seeds.english: I wouldn't like to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
seeds.korean: 저는 내일 무슨 일이 일어날지 추측하고 싶지는 않을 것 같아요
seeds.note: fyddwn i ddim yn licio = -고 싶지는 않을 것 같아요, kept apart from dw i ddim isio = -고 싶지 않아요 (eng_for_kor has these as a ZUT pair)

seeds.welsh: ti’n siarad Cymraeg yn dda iawn
seeds.english: you speak Welsh very well
seeds.korean: 당신은 웨일스어를 아주 잘 해요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n siarad Cymraeg trwy’r dydd?
seeds.english: do you speak Welsh all day?
seeds.korean: 당신은 하루 종일 웨일스어를 하나요?

seeds.welsh: a dw i isio i ti siarad Cymraeg efo fi ’fory
seeds.english: and I want you to speak Welsh with me tomorrow
seeds.korean: 그리고 저는 당신이 내일 저와 웨일스어로 이야기하기를 원해요

seeds.welsh: mae o isio dod yn ôl efo pawb arall nes ymlaen
seeds.english: he wants to come back with everyone else later on
seeds.korean: 그는 나중에 다른 모든 사람들과 함께 돌아오고 싶어해요

seeds.welsh: mae hi isio ffeindio allan be’ ydy’r ateb
seeds.english: she wants to find out what the answer is
seeds.korean: 그녀는 답이 무엇인지 알아내고 싶어해요

seeds.welsh: dan ni isio cyfarfod am chwech o’r gloch heno
seeds.english: we want to meet at six o'clock this evening
seeds.korean: 우리는 오늘 저녁 여섯 시에 만나고 싶어요
seeds.note: heno = 오늘 저녁 / 오늘 밤, both harmless

seeds.welsh: ond dw i ddim isio stopio siarad
seeds.english: but I don't want to stop talking
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 이야기하는 것을 멈추고 싶지 않아요

seeds.welsh: ti isio dysgu ei enw fo’n gyflym
seeds.english: you want to learn his name quickly
seeds.korean: 당신은 그의 이름을 빨리 배우고 싶어요
seeds.note: statement; the question form would be 싶나요?

seeds.welsh: pam wyt ti’n dysgu ei henw hi?
seeds.english: why are you learning her name?
seeds.korean: 당신은 왜 그녀의 이름을 배우고 있어요?

seeds.welsh: achos dw i isio cyfarfod pobl sy’n siarad Cymraeg
seeds.english: because I want to meet people who speak Welsh
seeds.korean: 왜냐하면 저는 웨일스어를 하는 사람들을 만나고 싶기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mynd i ddechrau siarad mwy cyn bo hir
seeds.english: I'm going to start talking more soon
seeds.korean: 저는 곧 더 많이 이야기하기 시작할 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn mynd i fedru cofio’n hawdd
seeds.english: I'm not going to be able to remember easily
seeds.korean: 저는 쉽게 기억할 수 없을 거예요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n mynd i helpu fi cyn i mi orfod mynd?
seeds.english: are you going to help me before I have to go?
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 가야 하기 전에 저를 도와줄 건가요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n licio teimlo fel taswn i bron yn barod i fynd
seeds.english: I like feeling as if I'm nearly ready to go
seeds.korean: 저는 거의 갈 준비가 된 것처럼 느끼는 것을 좋아해요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn licio cymryd gormod o amser i ateb
seeds.english: I don't like taking too much time to answer
seeds.korean: 저는 대답하는 데 시간을 너무 많이 들이는 것을 좋아하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddefnyddiol dechrau siarad cyn gynted ag y medri di
seeds.english: it's useful to start talking as soon as you can
seeds.korean: 당신이 할 수 있는 한 빨리 이야기하기 시작하는 것이 유용해요
seeds.note: generic you (medri di) kept as 당신; natural Korean drops it

seeds.welsh: dw i’n edrych ymlaen at siarad yn well cyn gynted ag y medra i
seeds.english: I'm looking forward to speaking better as soon as I can
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 할 수 있는 한 빨리 더 잘 이야기하게 되기를 기대하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: o’n i isio gofyn rhywbeth i ti ddoe
seeds.english: I wanted to ask you something yesterday
seeds.korean: 저는 어제 당신에게 무언가를 물어보고 싶었어요

seeds.welsh: oeddat ti isio siarad efo fi heno
seeds.english: you wanted to speak with me tonight
seeds.korean: 당신은 오늘 밤 저와 이야기하고 싶었어요

seeds.welsh: oeddat ti isio dangos rhywbeth i mi?
seeds.english: did you want to show me something?
seeds.korean: 당신은 저에게 무언가를 보여주고 싶었나요?

seeds.welsh: pa mor hir wyt ti ’di bod yn dysgu Cymraeg?
seeds.english: how long have you been learning Welsh?
seeds.korean: 당신은 웨일스어를 얼마나 오랫동안 배워 왔어요?

seeds.welsh: dydy o ddim isio bod yn ddistaw pan mae pobl eraill yma
seeds.english: he doesn't want to be quiet when other people are here
seeds.korean: 그는 다른 사람들이 여기 있을 때 조용히 있고 싶어하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dydy hi ddim isio darllen unrhyw beth pnawn ’ma
seeds.english: she doesn't want to read anything this afternoon
seeds.korean: 그녀는 오늘 오후에 아무것도 읽고 싶어하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dan ni ddim isio torri ar draws y stori
seeds.english: we don't want to interrupt the story
seeds.korean: 우리는 이야기를 끊고 싶지 않아요

seeds.welsh: wnes i ddechrau meddwl amdano fo’n ofalus mis diwetha’
seeds.english: I started to think about it carefully last month
seeds.korean: 저는 지난달에 그것에 대해 신중하게 생각하기 시작했어요

seeds.welsh: dw i wedi bod yn dysgu am tua wythnos
seeds.english: I've been learning for about a week
seeds.korean: 저는 일주일 정도 배워 왔어요

seeds.welsh: ond dw i wedi blino dipyn bach bore ’ma
seeds.english: but I'm a little tired this morning
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 오늘 아침에 조금 피곤해요

seeds.welsh: sut wyt ti’n teimlo ar hyn o bryd?
seeds.english: how do you feel at the moment?
seeds.korean: 당신은 지금 이 순간 기분이 어때요?
seeds.note: ar hyn o bryd = 지금 이 순간, because bare 지금 is rŵan; without this the prompt admits rŵan or ar hyn o bryd

seeds.welsh: dw i’n teimlo’n iawn, ond dw i’n dechrau blino
seeds.english: I feel okay, but I'm starting to feel tired
seeds.korean: 저는 기분이 괜찮아요, 하지만 피곤해지기 시작하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n dechrau teimlo’n well na neithiwr
seeds.english: I was starting to feel better than last night
seeds.korean: 저는 어젯밤보다 기분이 나아지기 시작하고 있었어요

seeds.welsh: do’n i ddim yn meddwl am sut i ateb
seeds.english: I wasn't thinking about how to answer
seeds.korean: 저는 어떻게 대답할지에 대해 생각하고 있지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: neu os dw i angen gwella
seeds.english: or if I need to improve
seeds.korean: 아니면 제가 나아질 필요가 있는지

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim angen gwybod popeth
seeds.english: I don't need to know everything
seeds.korean: 저는 모든 것을 알 필요가 없어요

seeds.welsh: ond dw i ddim yn poeni am wneud camgymeriadau
seeds.english: but I don't worry about making mistakes
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 실수하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: achos dw i’n meddwl fod o’n beth da i wneud camgymeriadau
seeds.english: because I think that it's a good thing to make mistakes
seeds.korean: 왜냐하면 저는 실수하는 것이 좋은 일이라고 생각하기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: does dim ots gen i am wneud camgymeriadau
seeds.english: I don't care about making mistakes
seeds.korean: 저는 실수하는 것은 상관없어요
seeds.note: does dim ots gen i = 상관없어요

seeds.welsh: mae o fel hyn, os ti’n gwybod be’ dw i’n ei olygu
seeds.english: it's like this, if you know what I mean
seeds.korean: 이런 거예요, 당신이 제 말이 무슨 뜻인지 안다면요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn trio gorffen mor gyflym â phosib
seeds.english: I'm not trying to finish as quickly as possible
seeds.korean: 저는 가능한 한 빨리 끝내려고 노력하고 있지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mwynhau gwneud pethau diddorol efo fy ffrindiau
seeds.english: I enjoy doing interesting things with my friends
seeds.korean: 저는 제 친구들과 흥미로운 일들을 하는 것을 즐겨요

seeds.welsh: oedd o isio sgwennu llythyr at ei ffrind wythnos diwetha’
seeds.english: he wanted to write a letter to his friend last week
seeds.korean: 그는 지난주에 그의 친구에게 편지를 쓰고 싶어했어요

seeds.welsh: oedd hi isio rhoi ei lythyr o yn ei bag hi
seeds.english: she wanted to put his letter in her bag
seeds.korean: 그녀는 그의 편지를 그녀의 가방에 넣고 싶어했어요

seeds.welsh: oeddan ni isio rhoi ychydig mwy o amser i ti
seeds.english: we wanted to give you a little more time
seeds.korean: 우리는 당신에게 시간을 조금 더 주고 싶었어요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn mwynhau deffro pan wnes i ddim cysgu’n dda iawn
seeds.english: I don't enjoy waking up when I didn't sleep very well
seeds.korean: 저는 잠을 아주 잘 자지 못했을 때 깨는 것을 즐기지 않아요

seeds.welsh: fel medra i gofio sut i ddeud ychydig o eiriau
seeds.english: so I can remember how to say a few words
seeds.korean: 제가 몇몇 단어를 어떻게 말하는지 기억할 수 있도록
seeds.note: fel = so that (purpose clause, a fragment); English "so I can" could also read as "therefore"; translated the Welsh

seeds.welsh: fedra i ddim cofio sut i ddeud be’ o’n i isio deud
seeds.english: I can't remember how to say what I wanted to say
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 말하고 싶었던 것을 어떻게 말하는지 기억할 수 없어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddiddorol pan ti’n dallt digon o eiriau
seeds.english: it's interesting when you understand enough words
seeds.korean: 당신이 충분한 단어를 이해할 때 흥미로워요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n gwybod sut i wneud be’ dw i angen gwneud wythnos nesa’
seeds.english: I know how to do what I need to do next week
seeds.korean: 저는 다음 주에 할 필요가 있는 일을 어떻게 하는지 알아요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn gwybod sut i ddeud digon o eiriau gwahanol hyd yn hyn
seeds.english: I don't know how to say enough different words yet
seeds.korean: 저는 아직 충분히 다양한 단어를 어떻게 말하는지 몰라요

seeds.welsh: fedri di ddeud hynna eto bach yn arafach?
seeds.english: could you say that again a little more slowly?
seeds.korean: 당신은 그걸 조금 더 천천히 다시 말해 줄 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn siŵr os medra i helpu chdi ar yr un pryd
seeds.english: I'm not sure if I can help you at the same time
seeds.korean: 저는 당신을 동시에 도울 수 있을지 확실하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n siŵr bod dim ots gen ti helpu fi?
seeds.english: are you sure you don't mind helping me?
seeds.korean: 당신은 저를 도와주는 게 상관없다고 확신하나요?

seeds.welsh: dydy dysgu Cymraeg ddim yn hawdd ond mae’n hwyl
seeds.english: learning Welsh isn't easy but it is fun
seeds.korean: 웨일스어를 배우는 것은 쉽지 않지만 재미있어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n bwysig cymryd amser i brofi dy hun
seeds.english: it's important to take time to test yourself
seeds.korean: 당신 자신을 시험해 볼 시간을 갖는 것이 중요해요
seeds.note: generic you (dy hun) as 당신 자신

seeds.welsh: dydy hi ddim yn anodd ffeindio’r ateb
seeds.english: it's not difficult to find the answer
seeds.korean: 답을 찾아내는 것은 어렵지 않아요
seeds.note: ffeindio = 찾아내다, chwilio am = 찾다 (seed 68); kept apart so 찾다 is not two Welsh verbs

seeds.welsh: pam wyt ti isio stopio?
seeds.english: why do you want to stop?
seeds.korean: 당신은 왜 멈추고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: be’ wyt ti’n chwilio amdano?
seeds.english: what are you looking for?
seeds.korean: 당신은 무엇을 찾고 있어요?

seeds.welsh: doedd o ddim isio edrych ar ôl y ci ifanc trwy’r pnawn
seeds.english: he didn't want to look after the young dog all afternoon
seeds.korean: 그는 오후 내내 어린 개를 돌보고 싶어하지 않았어요
seeds.note: y X (the) = bare Korean noun; y X 'na (that) = 그 X; y X 'ma (this) = 이 X

seeds.welsh: doedd hi ddim isio deud wrtha i lle oedd o
seeds.english: she didn't want to tell me where it was
seeds.korean: 그녀는 그것이 어디에 있었는지 저에게 말하고 싶어하지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: doeddan ni ddim isio gadael i neb glywed y gwir
seeds.english: we didn't want to let anyone hear the truth
seeds.korean: 우리는 아무도 진실을 듣게 하고 싶지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bo’ ti’n gwneud yn dda iawn
seeds.english: I think that you're doing very well
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 아주 잘하고 있다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: diolch yn fawr, ond mae gen i fwy i ddysgu
seeds.english: thank you very much, but I've got more to learn
seeds.korean: 정말 감사해요, 하지만 저는 더 배울 것이 있어요

seeds.welsh: diolch yn fawr am helpu fi i ddallt
seeds.english: thank you very much for helping me to understand
seeds.korean: 제가 이해하도록 도와줘서 정말 감사해요
seeds.note: no 당신: the Welsh has no ti either

seeds.welsh: oes gen ti fwy i ddysgu?
seeds.english: have you got more to learn?
seeds.korean: 당신은 더 배울 것이 있나요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n hapus iawn efo faint dw i wedi dysgu’n barod
seeds.english: I'm very happy with how much I've learnt already
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 이미 얼마나 많이 배웠는지에 아주 만족해요
seeds.note: hapus efo = 만족하다 here; elsewhere hapus = 기쁘다. Two Korean for one Welsh is the harmless direction

seeds.welsh: dw i’n synnu pa mor gyflym dw i’n dechrau dallt
seeds.english: I'm surprised at how quickly I'm starting to understand
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 얼마나 빨리 이해하기 시작하고 있는지 놀라워요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn dallt be’ ddudest ti
seeds.english: I don't understand what you said
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 말한 것을 이해하지 못해요

seeds.welsh: pryd wnest ti ddechrau dysgu?
seeds.english: when did you start to learn?
seeds.korean: 당신은 언제 배우기 시작했어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn siŵr pryd fydda i’n barod
seeds.english: I'm not sure when I'll be ready
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 언제 준비가 될지 확실하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: pryd wyt ti isio dechrau?
seeds.english: when do you want to start?
seeds.korean: 당신은 언제 시작하고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn mynd i aros amdanat ti. pam ddim?
seeds.english: I'm not going to wait for you. Why not?
seeds.korean: 저는 당신을 기다리지 않을 거예요. 왜요?
seeds.note: pam ddim? (why not) has no clean short Korean; 왜요? would also fit pam? Alternative: 왜 안 기다려요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n cytuno efo be’ ddudest ti am dy ffrind
seeds.english: I agree with what you said about your friend
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 당신의 친구에 대해 말한 것에 동의해요
seeds.note: two 당신 in one line reads heavy; kept for the dy/ti

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn cytuno efo be’ ddudodd o am fy ffrind
seeds.english: I don't agree with what he said about my friend
seeds.korean: 저는 그가 제 친구에 대해 말한 것에 동의하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn nabod y bobl ’na
seeds.english: I don't know those people
seeds.korean: 저는 그 사람들을 몰라요
seeds.note: nabod (know a person) and gwybod (know a fact) are both 알다; the object decides. Course-wide note

seeds.welsh: doedd o ddim yn bosib, yn anffodus
seeds.english: it wasn't possible, unfortunately
seeds.korean: 안타깝게도 그것은 가능하지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: pobl dw i ddim yn nabod ydyn nhw
seeds.english: they are people I don't know
seeds.korean: 그들은 제가 모르는 사람들이에요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn barod i siarad efo pobl dw i ddim yn nabod hyd yn hyn
seeds.english: I'm not ready to talk to people I don't know yet
seeds.korean: 저는 아직 제가 모르는 사람들과 이야기할 준비가 안 됐어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bo’ fi wedi gwneud llawer mewn amser byr
seeds.english: I think that I've done a lot in a short time
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 짧은 시간에 많이 했다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: os medri di siarad yn arafach, fyddai hynna’n wych
seeds.english: if you can speak more slowly that would be great
seeds.korean: 당신이 더 천천히 이야기할 수 있으면, 그건 훌륭할 거예요

seeds.welsh: mae’n anodd meddwl yn ddigon cyflym i ateb mewn pryd
seeds.english: it's difficult to think quickly enough to answer in time
seeds.korean: 제때 대답할 만큼 충분히 빨리 생각하는 것은 어려워요

seeds.welsh: liciwn i gario ymlaen i wneud hyn am dipyn
seeds.english: I'd like to keep on doing this for a while
seeds.korean: 저는 이걸 한동안 계속하면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n amser mynd rŵan
seeds.english: it's time to go now
seeds.korean: 지금 갈 시간이에요

seeds.welsh: dyma’r unig ffordd fydd o’n gweithio
seeds.english: this is the only way it will work
seeds.korean: 이것이 그게 작동할 유일한 방법이에요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n barod i fynd adre ar y bws nesa’?
seeds.english: are you ready to go home on the next bus?
seeds.korean: 당신은 다음 버스로 집에 갈 준비가 됐나요?

seeds.welsh: na, dw i ddim yn barod hyd yn hyn, dw i angen ychydig mwy o amser
seeds.english: no I'm not ready yet, I need a little more time
seeds.korean: 아니요, 저는 아직 준비가 안 됐어요, 저는 시간이 조금 더 필요해요

seeds.welsh: yndw, dw i’n barod i fynd cyn gynted â ti isio
seeds.english: yes I'm ready to go as soon as you want
seeds.korean: 네, 저는 당신이 원하는 대로 바로 갈 준비가 됐어요
seeds.note: Welsh yes/no echoes the verb (yndw, do, oes, ydy...); Korean 네/아니요 cannot carry which one. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: dylwn i ystyried chwarae rhywbeth arall
seeds.english: I should consider playing something else
seeds.korean: 저는 다른 걸 가지고 노는 걸 고려하는 게 좋겠어요
seeds.note: chwarae rhywbeth arall: sense (a game? an instrument?) unclear in both; rendered "play with". dylwn = -는 게 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: dylet ti ofyn i dy hun pam dydy o ddim yn gweithio
seeds.english: you should ask yourself why it's not working
seeds.korean: 당신은 그게 왜 작동하지 않는지 당신 자신에게 물어보는 게 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: ddylet ti ddim poeni am wneud rhywbeth tebyg
seeds.english: you shouldn't worry about doing something similar
seeds.korean: 당신은 비슷한 것을 하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않는 게 좋겠어요
seeds.note: ddylet ti ddim = -지 않는 게 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mwynhau ffeindio allan mwy am yr iaith ’ma
seeds.english: I'm enjoying finding out more about this language
seeds.korean: 저는 이 언어에 대해 더 많이 알아내는 것을 즐기고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dan ni’n trio deud fod o ddim fel ’na
seeds.english: we're trying to say that it's not like that
seeds.korean: 우리는 그게 그렇지 않다고 말하려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dan ni ddim yn trio clywed llawer mwy o eiriau
seeds.english: we're not trying to hear many more words
seeds.korean: 우리는 훨씬 더 많은 단어를 들으려고 노력하고 있지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dan ni angen newid be’ dan ni’n gwneud
seeds.english: we need to change what we're doing
seeds.korean: 우리는 우리가 하고 있는 것을 바꿀 필요가 있어요

seeds.welsh: dyna pam doedd o ddim yn gwybod yr ateb
seeds.english: that is why he didn't know the answer
seeds.korean: 그것이 그가 답을 몰랐던 이유예요
seeds.note: dyna pam = 그것이 ~ 이유예요 (kept literal so 127 can mirror it)

seeds.welsh: dan ni ddim angen teimlo’n hapus, dan ni jesd angen gweithio’n galed
seeds.english: we don't need to feel happy, we just need to work hard
seeds.korean: 우리는 행복하다고 느낄 필요는 없어요, 우리는 그냥 열심히 일할 필요가 있어요

seeds.welsh: oeddan ni’n gobeithio gweld be’ oeddat ti’n gwneud
seeds.english: we hoped to see what you were doing
seeds.korean: 우리는 당신이 무엇을 하고 있었는지 보기를 바랐어요

seeds.welsh: doeddan ni ddim yn gobeithio deffro yng nghanol y nos
seeds.english: we didn't hope to wake in the middle of the night
seeds.korean: 우리는 한밤중에 깨기를 바라지 않았어요
seeds.note: HC Welsh keeps gobeithio (hope); the canonical English was changed to "expect" (C0108, #374) in other courses but not here. Translated the Welsh

seeds.welsh: rhaid i ni weithio’n galed i ddysgu llawer o eiriau newydd
seeds.english: we must work hard to learn a lot of new words
seeds.korean: 우리는 새로운 단어를 많이 배우기 위해 열심히 일해야 해요

seeds.welsh: dan ni’n ffrindiau, ac ar ôl i ni orffen liciwn i ymlacio
seeds.english: we're friends, and after we finish I'd like to relax
seeds.korean: 우리는 친구예요, 그리고 우리가 끝낸 후에 저는 느긋하게 쉬면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: pan dan ni’n dysgu rhywbeth newydd mae’n newid ein hymennydd ni
seeds.english: when we learn something new it changes our brain
seeds.korean: 우리가 새로운 것을 배울 때 그것은 우리의 뇌를 바꿔요

seeds.welsh: oedd hynna’n ddiddorol iawn, a do’n i ddim yn disgwyl o
seeds.english: that was very interesting, and I wasn't expecting it
seeds.korean: 그건 아주 흥미로웠어요, 그리고 저는 그걸 예상하고 있지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: pam fedra i ddim cofio be’ ddudest ti?
seeds.english: why can't I remember what you said?
seeds.korean: 저는 왜 당신이 말한 것을 기억할 수 없어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n teimlo fel taswn i’n gwneud yn waeth heddiw na ddoe
seeds.english: I feel as if I'm doing worse today than yesterday
seeds.korean: 저는 오늘 어제보다 더 못하고 있는 것처럼 느껴요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn teimlo fel taswn i’n barod i gael sgwrs
seeds.english: I don't feel as if I'm ready to have a conversation
seeds.korean: 저는 대화를 할 준비가 된 것처럼 느끼지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dydy hwn ddim y dewis gorau fedrwn i wneud
seeds.english: this isn't the best choice I could make
seeds.korean: 이건 제가 할 수 있을 최고의 선택이 아니에요
seeds.note: fedrwn i (could, conditional) vs medra i (can) both sit on -ㄹ 수 있다; -ㄹ 수 있을 is the nearest mark. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: dw i’n bendant yn gwneud yn well nag o’n i tro diwetha’ wnaethon ni siarad efo’n gilydd
seeds.english: I'm definitely doing better than I was last time we talked to each other
seeds.korean: 저는 우리가 지난번에 서로 이야기했을 때보다 분명히 더 잘하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n teimlo’n well nag o’n i’n teimlo pan oeddan ni yn y dafarn
seeds.english: I feel better than I felt when we were in the pub
seeds.korean: 저는 우리가 펍에 있었을 때 느꼈던 것보다 기분이 더 나아요

seeds.welsh: ga i ofyn rhywbeth i ti cyn i ti adael?
seeds.english: can I ask you something before you leave?
seeds.korean: 당신이 떠나기 전에 제가 당신에게 뭔가 물어봐도 될까요?

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddiddorol bo’ ti’n licio mynd ar y bws
seeds.english: it's interesting that you like to go by bus
seeds.korean: 당신이 버스로 가는 것을 좋아한다는 게 흥미로워요

seeds.welsh: mae’n anarferol bo’ ti ddim yn licio defnyddio dy gar
seeds.english: it's unusual that you don't like to use your car
seeds.korean: 당신이 당신의 차를 쓰는 것을 좋아하지 않는다는 게 특이해요
seeds.note: 당신 + 당신의 heavy; kept for dy

seeds.welsh: mae’n dechrau teimlo’n haws a dw i’n gyffrous am sut mae’n mynd
seeds.english: it's starting to feel easier and I'm excited about how it's going
seeds.korean: 더 쉽게 느껴지기 시작하고 있고, 저는 그게 어떻게 되어 가는지 설레요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bod hynna’n syniad da
seeds.english: I think that's a good idea
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 좋은 아이디어라고 생각해요
seeds.note: syniad = 아이디어, kept apart from meddwl = 생각하다

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n meddwl bod hynna’n syniad da
seeds.english: I thought that was a good idea
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 좋은 아이디어라고 생각했어요
seeds.note: imperfect (o'n i'n meddwl) and preterite (wnes i feddwl) both = 생각했어요. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: dw i’n credu bod dy syniad di wedi bod yn dda iawn
seeds.english: I believe that your idea was very good
seeds.korean: 저는 당신의 아이디어가 아주 좋았다고 믿어요

seeds.welsh: mae’r gwaith ’ma’n newid siâp fy ymennydd i
seeds.english: this work is changing the shape of my brain
seeds.korean: 이 일은 제 뇌의 모양을 바꾸고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dim dyna pam o’n i isio gweld chdi
seeds.english: that isn't why I wanted to see you
seeds.korean: 그게 제가 당신을 보고 싶었던 이유는 아니에요

seeds.welsh: ti fel rhywun o’n i’n arfer nabod
seeds.english: you're like someone I used to know
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 예전에 알던 사람 같아요

seeds.welsh: dw i mor hapus bo’ ti’n gwneud mor dda
seeds.english: I'm so happy that you're doing so well
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 그렇게 잘하고 있어서 정말 행복해요

seeds.welsh: oedd hynna’n syndod, achos mae o’n ffrind i mi
seeds.english: that was a surprise, because he's my friend
seeds.korean: 그건 놀라운 일이었어요, 왜냐하면 그는 제 친구이기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: mae ’na ormod o syniadau’n mynd rownd yn fy mhen
seeds.english: there are too many ideas going around in my head
seeds.korean: 제 머릿속에 너무 많은 아이디어가 맴돌고 있어요

seeds.welsh: mae hynna’n llai cyffrous na be’ oedd hi’n deud
seeds.english: that's less exciting than what she was saying
seeds.korean: 그건 그녀가 말하고 있던 것보다 덜 흥미진진해요

seeds.welsh: ti’n dod i nabod rhywun yn dda iawn pan dach chi’n gweithio efo’ch gilydd
seeds.english: you get to know someone very well when you work together
seeds.korean: 당신과 누군가가 함께 일할 때, 당신은 그 사람을 아주 잘 알게 돼요
seeds.note: Welsh switches ti -> dach chi (you + them) mid-sentence; 당신과 누군가가 carries the chi. Clause order swapped to keep it natural

seeds.welsh: dydy hi ddim yn broblem pan ti’n gweithio ar rywbeth anodd efo nhw
seeds.english: it's not a problem when you work at something difficult with them
seeds.korean: 당신이 그들과 함께 어려운 것을 작업할 때 그건 문제가 아니에요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn gwybod pam ti’n meddwl fod o mor dda
seeds.english: I don't know why you think that it's so good
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 왜 그게 그렇게 좋다고 생각하는지 몰라요

seeds.welsh: wrth gwrs gei di ofyn iddi hi achos mae hi’n ffrind i mi
seeds.english: of course you can ask her because she's my friend
seeds.korean: 물론 당신은 그녀에게 물어봐도 돼요, 왜냐하면 그녀는 제 친구이기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: mae’n bwysicach siarad yn aml na bod yn berffaith
seeds.english: it's more important to talk often than to be perfect
seeds.korean: 완벽한 것보다 자주 이야기하는 것이 더 중요해요

seeds.welsh: fan hyn oedd fy ffrind isio cyfarfod ni
seeds.english: this was where my friend wanted to meet us
seeds.korean: 여기가 제 친구가 우리를 만나고 싶어했던 곳이에요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddrwg gen i bo’ fi angen gadael mor gynnar
seeds.english: I'm sorry that I need to leave so early
seeds.korean: 제가 이렇게 일찍 떠날 필요가 있어서 미안해요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddrwg gen i bo’ fi ddim yn medru gweld be’ ti’n trio dangos i mi
seeds.english: I'm sorry that I can't see what you're trying to show me
seeds.korean: 당신이 저에게 보여주려고 노력하고 있는 것을 제가 볼 수 없어서 미안해요

seeds.welsh: dim problem. mae popeth yn iawn
seeds.english: no problem. Everything is okay
seeds.korean: 문제없어요. 모든 게 괜찮아요

seeds.welsh: mae hynna’n garedig iawn ohonot ti a dw i’n ddiolchgar i ti am helpu
seeds.english: that's very kind of you and I'm grateful to you for helping
seeds.korean: 그건 당신이 정말 친절한 거예요, 그리고 저는 도와줘서 당신에게 고마워요
seeds.note: "kind of you" has no 해요 equivalent without -시- (친절하시네요); diolchgar = 고마워요, diolch = 감사해요

seeds.welsh: mae o’r un peth â be’ oeddan ni’n siarad amdano gynnau
seeds.english: it's the same thing as we were talking about earlier
seeds.korean: 그건 우리가 아까 이야기하고 있던 것과 같은 거예요

seeds.welsh: wnes i ddeffro’n gynharach nag o’n i isio bore ’ma
seeds.english: I woke earlier than I wanted to this morning
seeds.korean: 저는 오늘 아침에 제가 원했던 것보다 더 일찍 깼어요

seeds.welsh: pam dwyt ti ddim yn hapus bellach?
seeds.english: why are you not happy any more?
seeds.korean: 당신은 왜 더 이상 행복하지 않아요?

seeds.welsh: does dim byd i weld yn gweithio ers i ni drio’i drwsio fo
seeds.english: nothing seems to be working since we tried to fix it
seeds.korean: 우리가 그걸 고치려고 노력한 후로 아무것도 작동하지 않는 것 같아요

seeds.welsh: oedd hi’n garedig iawn pan welodd hi fi’n teimlo’n nerfus
seeds.english: she was very kind when she saw me feeling nervous
seeds.korean: 그녀는 제가 긴장하는 걸 봤을 때 아주 친절했어요

seeds.welsh: doedd o ddim yn amyneddgar iawn pan do’n i ddim yn medru ateb
seeds.english: he wasn't very patient when I couldn't answer
seeds.korean: 그는 제가 대답할 수 없었을 때 아주 참을성 있지는 않았어요

seeds.welsh: dydy hwn ddim yn anodd iawn, felly dw i’n gobeithio byddi di’n gorffen cyn bo hir
seeds.english: this isn't very difficult, so I hope you'll finish soon
seeds.korean: 이건 아주 어렵지 않아요, 그래서 저는 당신이 곧 끝내기를 바라요

seeds.welsh: fedri di ddeud wrtha i be’ ydy dy enw di?
seeds.english: can you tell me what your name is?
seeds.korean: 당신은 저에게 당신의 이름이 뭔지 말해 줄 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: dim hynna o’n i’n gobeithio fyddai’n digwydd
seeds.english: that wasn't what I was hoping would happen
seeds.korean: 그건 제가 일어나기를 바라고 있던 일이 아니었어요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i wedi gwneud o’n wahanol ’swn i wedi gwybod be’ oeddat ti isio
seeds.english: I would have done it differently if I had known what you wanted
seeds.korean: 제가 당신이 원했던 것을 알았더라면, 저는 그걸 다르게 했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i ddim wedi deud o’n union yr un ffordd
seeds.english: I wouldn't have said it in exactly the same way
seeds.korean: 저는 그걸 정확히 같은 방법으로 말하지는 않았을 거예요
seeds.note: ffordd = 방법, kept apart from dull = 방식 (441)

seeds.welsh: lle wyt ti isio cyfarfod nos Sadwrn?
seeds.english: where do you want to meet on Saturday night?
seeds.korean: 당신은 토요일 밤에 어디에서 만나고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: does dim ots gen i aros am ychydig funudau bore ’fory
seeds.english: I don't mind waiting for a few minutes tomorrow morning
seeds.korean: 저는 내일 아침에 몇 분 기다리는 것은 상관없어요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti isio mynd i fwyty heno?
seeds.english: do you want to go to a restaurant tonight?
seeds.korean: 당신은 오늘 밤 식당에 가고 싶나요?

seeds.welsh: fydda i ddim yn medru bod yno mis nesa’
seeds.english: I won't be able to be there next month
seeds.korean: 저는 다음 달에 거기에 있을 수 없을 거예요

seeds.welsh: gadewch i ni siarad am rywbeth arall
seeds.english: let's talk about something else
seeds.korean: 우리 다른 것에 대해 이야기하기로 해요
seeds.note: "let's" in 해요 (이야기해요) is identical to "we talk"; -기로 해요 is the least-bad clear form. gadewch is a chi form in a fixed phrase; Korean carries nothing of it

seeds.welsh: dim hynna dw i’n trio deud
seeds.english: that isn't what I'm trying to say
seeds.korean: 그게 제가 말하려고 하는 게 아니에요
seeds.note: trio deud = 말하려고 하다 here (말하려고 노력하다 reads oddly); harmless direction

seeds.welsh: sut wyt ti’n deud y gair ’ma yn y Gymraeg?
seeds.english: how do you say this word in Welsh?
seeds.korean: 당신은 이 단어를 웨일스어로 어떻게 말해요?

seeds.welsh: fedri di roi’r llyfr ’na i mi fore dydd Sul?

seeds.korean: 네, 그들은 그들이 이해하는지 확실히 할 필요가 있어요

seeds.welsh: bydden nhw’n licio caru ei gilydd ond maen nhw’n anhapus
seeds.english: they would like to love each other but they're unhappy
seeds.korean: 그들은 서로 사랑하고 싶어할 거예요, 하지만 그들은 불행해요
seeds.note: 3rd-person "would like" (bydden nhw'n licio) = -고 싶어할 거예요, which also fits future "they will want"

seeds.welsh: fydden nhw ddim yn licio i ti feddwl bo’ nhw wedi diflasu
seeds.english: they wouldn't like you to think that they're bored
seeds.korean: 그들은 당신이 그들이 지루해한다고 생각하는 걸 원하지 않을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fydden nhw’n licio ymweld â ni ddydd Mawrth?
seeds.english: would they like to visit us on Tuesday?
seeds.korean: 그들은 화요일에 우리를 방문하고 싶어할까요?

seeds.welsh: bydden, byddai hynna’n berffaith iddyn nhw
seeds.english: yes that would be perfect for them
seeds.korean: 네, 그건 그들에게 완벽할 거예요

seeds.welsh: na, fyddai hynna ddim yn bosib
seeds.english: no that wouldn't be possible
seeds.korean: 아니요, 그건 가능하지 않을 거예요

seeds.welsh: dydyn nhw ddim yn barod hyd yn hyn ond byddan nhw’n barod yn fuan
seeds.english: they're not ready yet but they'll be ready soon
seeds.korean: 그들은 아직 준비가 안 됐지만 머지않아 준비가 될 거예요

seeds.welsh: mi fydden nhw’n medru golygu bo’ nhw isio i ti ofyn
seeds.english: they could mean that they want you to ask
seeds.korean: 그들은 당신이 물어보기를 원한다는 뜻일 수 있을 텐데요

seeds.welsh: doeddan nhw ddim yn medru ffeindio allan pryd oedd y ffilm yn dechrau
seeds.english: they couldn't find out when the film started
seeds.korean: 그들은 영화가 언제 시작하는지 알아낼 수 없었어요

seeds.welsh: fedran nhw dorri nifer y myfyrwyr maen nhw’n cymryd?
seeds.english: could they cut the number of students they take?
seeds.korean: 그들은 그들이 받는 학생 수를 줄일 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: medran, mi fedran nhw tasen nhw isio
seeds.english: yes they could if they wanted to
seeds.korean: 네, 그들이 원한다면 할 수 있어요

seeds.welsh: na, mae ’na isafswm maen nhw angen
seeds.english: no there's a minimum number they need
seeds.korean: 아니요, 그들이 필요한 최소 인원이 있어요

seeds.welsh: oeddan nhw isio codi cymaint â phosib at elusen
seeds.english: they wanted to raise as much as possible for charity
seeds.korean: 그들은 자선 단체를 위해 가능한 한 많이 모금하고 싶어했어요

seeds.welsh: doeddan nhw ddim isio penderfynu be’ ddylai fo wneud
seeds.english: they didn't want to decide what he should do
seeds.korean: 그들은 그가 무엇을 하는 게 좋을지 결정하고 싶어하지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: dydyn nhw ddim isio marw
seeds.english: they don't want to die
seeds.korean: 그들은 죽고 싶어하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: maen nhw isio teithio tra maen nhw dal yn ifanc
seeds.english: they want to travel while they're still young
seeds.korean: 그들은 아직 젊을 때 여행하고 싶어해요

seeds.welsh: dull
seeds.english: a method
seeds.korean: 방식
seeds.note: fragment. dull = 방식, kept apart from ffordd = 방법; bare 방법 would admit both

seeds.welsh: oeddan nhw isio datblygu dull newydd?
seeds.english: did they want to develop a new method?
seeds.korean: 그들은 새로운 방식을 개발하고 싶어했나요?
seeds.note: HC English "method" matches the Welsh; original 668 English was "approach"

seeds.welsh: na, oeddan nhw isio cario ymlaen i wneud o yn yr un ffordd
seeds.english: no they wanted to keep doing it the same way
seeds.korean: 아니요, 그들은 그걸 같은 방법으로 계속하고 싶어했어요

seeds.welsh: oeddan, oeddan nhw’n meddwl bod modd gwneud o’n fwy effeithlon
seeds.english: yes they thought it could be done more efficiently
seeds.korean: 네, 그들은 그걸 더 효율적으로 할 수 있다고 생각했어요

seeds.welsh: byddan nhw’n medru cario’r cês ’na
seeds.english: they will be able to carry that suitcase
seeds.korean: 그들은 그 여행 가방을 들고 갈 수 있을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyddan nhw ddim yn medru torri’r ffenest ’na
seeds.english: they won't be able to break that window
seeds.korean: 그들은 그 창문을 깰 수 없을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyddan nhw’n medru dreifio ni adre ar ôl y pryd o fwyd?
seeds.english: will they be able to drive us home after the meal?
seeds.korean: 그들은 식사 후에 우리를 집까지 차로 데려다줄 수 있을까요?

seeds.welsh: byddan, byddan nhw’n hapus i helpu
seeds.english: yes they'll be happy to help
seeds.korean: 네, 그들은 기꺼이 도와줄 거예요

seeds.welsh: ddudon nhw bo’ nhw bron yn barod
seeds.english: they said that they were almost ready
seeds.korean: 그들은 거의 준비가 됐다고 말했어요

seeds.welsh: na, mae’n rhaid iddyn nhw ddal y trên eu hunain
seeds.english: no they have to catch the train themselves
seeds.korean: 아니요, 그들은 스스로 기차를 타야 해요

seeds.welsh: ddudon nhw be’ oeddan nhw isio gwneud
seeds.english: they said what they wanted to do
seeds.korean: 그들은 그들이 무엇을 하고 싶은지 말했어요

seeds.welsh: wnaethon nhw ddim deud be’ oeddan nhw isio gwneud
seeds.english: they didn't say what they wanted to do
seeds.korean: 그들은 그들이 무엇을 하고 싶은지 말하지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: ddudon nhw pwy welon nhw neithiwr?
seeds.english: did they say who they saw last night?
seeds.korean: 그들은 어젯밤에 누구를 봤는지 말했나요?

seeds.welsh: daeth ein ffrindiau ni draw tua chwech o’r gloch
seeds.english: our friends came round at about six o'clock
seeds.korean: 우리 친구들이 여섯 시쯤 놀러 왔어요

seeds.welsh: oedd rhaid i ni adael achos oedd y plant wedi blino
seeds.english: we had to leave because the children were tired
seeds.korean: 우리는 아이들이 피곤해서 떠나야 했어요

seeds.welsh: efallai bod o yno ond dydy o ddim yn debygol iawn
seeds.english: he might be there but it's not very likely
seeds.korean: 그가 거기에 있을지도 모르지만 그럴 가능성은 아주 높지 않아요

seeds.welsh: rhan o’r broblem ydy nifer yr ardaloedd gwahanol
seeds.english: part of the problem is the number of different areas
seeds.korean: 문제의 일부는 서로 다른 지역의 수예요

seeds.welsh: oedd o i gyd yn llawer haws yn y gorffennol
seeds.english: it was all much easier in the past
seeds.korean: 과거에는 그게 모두 훨씬 더 쉬웠어요

seeds.welsh: doedd o ddim o flaen yr arwydd glas
seeds.english: it wasn't in front of the blue sign
seeds.korean: 그건 파란 표지판 앞에 있지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: dw i isio ffeindio siop yn agos at y gwesty
seeds.english: I want to find a shop near the hotel
seeds.korean: 저는 호텔 가까이에 있는 가게를 찾아내고 싶어요

seeds.welsh: siop lle medra i brynu ychydig o gardiau post
seeds.english: a shop where I can buy some postcards
seeds.korean: 제가 엽서를 몇 장 살 수 있는 가게

seeds.welsh: wnaeth fy nhaid ymladd yn yr Eidal yn ystod y rhyfel
seeds.english: my grandfather fought in Italy during the war
seeds.korean: 제 할아버지는 전쟁 중에 이탈리아에서 싸웠어요
seeds.note: ymladd and cwffio (410) are both 싸우다; war context points to ymladd

seeds.welsh: rhif fy ystafell
seeds.english: my room number
seeds.korean: 제 방 번호

seeds.welsh: ddudes i rif fy ystafell wrthi unwaith ond wnaeth hi anghofio fo
seeds.english: I told her my room number once but she forgot it
seeds.korean: 저는 그녀에게 제 방 번호를 한 번 말했지만 그녀는 그걸 잊어버렸어요

seeds.welsh: tro nesa’ bydda i’n gofyn iddi beth ydy ei henw hi
seeds.english: next time I will ask her what her name is
seeds.korean: 다음번에 저는 그녀에게 그녀의 이름이 무엇인지 물어볼 거예요

seeds.welsh: gad i mi daflu fo dros y wal
seeds.english: let me throw it over the wall
seeds.korean: 제가 그걸 벽 너머로 던지게 해 줘요

seeds.welsh: mae o wrth ymyl y maes parcio
seeds.english: it's next to the car park
seeds.korean: 그건 주차장 옆에 있어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n fyd mawr
seeds.english: it's a big world
seeds.korean: 큰 세상이에요

seeds.welsh: ond dydy hynna ddim yn golygu na fedrwn ni ei newid
seeds.english: but that doesn't mean we can't change it
seeds.korean: 하지만 그게 우리가 그걸 바꿀 수 없다는 뜻은 아니에요

seeds.welsh: pa mor uchel wyt ti isio dringo cyn i ni stopio?
seeds.english: how high do you want to climb before we stop?
seeds.korean: 당신은 우리가 멈추기 전에 얼마나 높이 올라가고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: wyt ti isio stopio am saib?
seeds.english: do you want to stop for a rest?
seeds.korean: 당신은 휴식을 위해 멈추고 싶나요?

seeds.welsh: rhan o’r broblem ydy nad ydan ni ddim yn gwybod y ffeithiau
seeds.english: part of the problem is that we don't know the facts
seeds.korean: 문제의 일부는 우리가 사실을 모른다는 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim isio fo
seeds.english: I don't want it
seeds.korean: 저는 그걸 원하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim isio fo hyd yn oed fel cynnig rhad ac am ddim
seeds.english: I don't even want it as a free offer
seeds.korean: 저는 그걸 무료 제공으로도 원하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: mae ’na lawer o resymau i ystyried aros
seeds.english: there are many reasons to consider waiting
seeds.korean: 기다리는 것을 고려할 이유가 많이 있어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n aros tan ddiwedd yr ail hanner
seeds.english: I'm waiting for the end of the second half
seeds.korean: 저는 후반전이 끝날 때까지 기다리고 있어요

seeds.welsh: mae o wedi bod yn sâl ers ail ddiwrnod y gwyliau
seeds.english: he's been sick since the second day of the holidays
seeds.korean: 그는 휴가 둘째 날부터 계속 아파요

seeds.welsh: mae ganddi galon mor garedig
seeds.english: she has such a kind heart
seeds.korean: 그녀는 정말 친절한 마음을 가지고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dyna’r lleia’ o’n i’n medru gwneud
seeds.english: it's the least I could do
seeds.korean: 그게 제가 할 수 있었던 최소한이에요

seeds.welsh: beth bynnag mae o’n ddeud, dydy o ddim yn bell o’n blaenau ni rŵan
seeds.english: whatever he says it's not far ahead now
seeds.korean: 그가 뭐라고 말하든, 그건 이제 우리 앞에서 멀지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dyna’r unig obaith real sydd ar ôl i ni
seeds.english: it's the only real hope we have left
seeds.korean: 그게 우리에게 남은 유일한 진짜 희망이에요

seeds.welsh: yr unig obaith real ydy nad ydyn nhw ddim o ddifri’
seeds.english: the only real hope is that they're not serious
seeds.korean: 유일한 진짜 희망은 그들이 진지하지 않다는 거예요

seeds.welsh: dydy bywyd ddim yn hawdd ond dydy o ddim i fod yn hawdd
seeds.english: life isn't easy but it's not meant to be easy
seeds.korean: 인생은 쉽지 않지만, 원래 쉬운 게 아니에요

seeds.welsh: mae o i fod yn her
seeds.english: it's meant to be a challenge
seeds.korean: 그건 원래 도전인 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyddai dim byd yn gwneud fi’n hapusach na dianc
seeds.english: nothing would make me happier than to escape
seeds.korean: 도망치는 것보다 저를 더 행복하게 해 줄 건 아무것도 없을 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bod dy lygaid di’n hardd
seeds.english: I think your eyes are beautiful
seeds.korean: 저는 당신의 눈이 아름답다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: mae o o dan y bont
seeds.english: it's under the bridge
seeds.korean: 그건 다리 아래에 있어요

seeds.welsh: mae o ar ochr arall y llinell felen yna
seeds.english: it's on the other side of that yellow line
seeds.korean: 그건 그 노란 선의 반대편에 있어요

seeds.welsh: os na wnei di banad cryf o goffi i mi rŵan hyn
seeds.english: if you don't make me a strong cup of coffee right now
seeds.korean: 당신이 지금 당장 저에게 진한 커피 한 잔을 만들어 주지 않으면

seeds.welsh: wedyn fydda i byth yn ymddiried yn neb byth eto
seeds.english: then I will never trust anyone ever again
seeds.korean: 그러면 저는 다시는 절대 아무도 신뢰하지 않을 거예요
seeds.note: ymddiried = 신뢰하다, kept apart from credu = 믿다

seeds.welsh: dw i’n caru’r ffordd ti’n trio helpu
seeds.english: I love the way you try to help
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 도우려고 노력하는 방법을 사랑해요
seeds.note: ffordd = 방법 kept; natural Korean would say 모습

seeds.welsh: pa un o’r llefydd yna wyt ti’n meddwl ydy’r un mwya’ diddorol?
seeds.english: which of those places do you think is the most interesting?
seeds.korean: 당신은 그 장소들 중에 어디가 가장 흥미롭다고 생각해요?

seeds.welsh: beth ddaw nesa’?
seeds.english: what's going to come next?
seeds.korean: 다음에 무엇이 올 거예요?

seeds.welsh: beth sy’n digwydd ar ôl rhan gynta’r sioe?
seeds.english: what happens after the first part of the show?
seeds.korean: 쇼의 첫 부분이 끝난 후에 무슨 일이 일어나요?

seeds.welsh: pan fydd hi’n cyfri’
seeds.english: when it matters
seeds.korean: 중요할 때

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn bwriadu colli pan fydd hi wirioneddol yn cyfri’
seeds.english: I'm not planning to lose when it really matters
seeds.korean: 저는 정말 중요할 때 질 생각이 없어요

seeds.welsh: mae hynna’n swnio fel bod angen i ti gael ychydig o gwsg
seeds.english: that sounds as though you need to get some sleep
seeds.korean: 그건 당신이 잠을 좀 잘 필요가 있는 것처럼 들려요

seeds.welsh: mae o’n sefyll ar ei ben ei hun draw acw o fewn y fynedfa
seeds.english: he's standing alone over there inside the entrance
seeds.korean: 그는 저기 입구 안에 혼자 서 있어요

seeds.welsh: efallai dylen ni agor y drws a chau’r ffenest
seeds.english: maybe we should open the door and close the window
seeds.korean: 어쩌면 우리는 문을 열고 창문을 닫는 게 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: pam dwyt ti ddim isio eistedd rhwng y ddwy hogan?
seeds.english: why don't you want to sit between the two girls?
seeds.korean: 당신은 왜 두 여자아이 사이에 앉고 싶지 않아요?

seeds.welsh: taswn i ond yn medru ymddiried ynddoch chi i chwarae efo’ch gilydd heb ddadlau
seeds.english: if only I could trust you to play together without arguing
seeds.korean: 제가 여러분이 다투지 않고 함께 놀 거라고 신뢰할 수만 있다면
seeds.note: fragment (a wish). chi with no gyd = 여러분; chi gyd = 여러분 모두

seeds.welsh: bu bron iddi fynd ar goll achos iddi droi i’r chwith yn hytrach nag i’r dde
seeds.english: she almost got lost because she turned left instead of right
seeds.korean: 그녀는 오른쪽 대신 왼쪽으로 돌아서 길을 잃을 뻔했어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n casáu codi twrw ond un fi ydy hwnnw
seeds.english: I hate making trouble but that one's mine
seeds.korean: 저는 소란 피우는 걸 싫어하지만 그건 제 거예요
seeds.note: casáu = 싫어하다, kept apart from ddim yn licio = 좋아하지 않다

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mynd i redeg ar draws y gwellt
seeds.english: I'm going to run across the grass
seeds.korean: 저는 잔디를 가로질러 달릴 거예요

seeds.welsh: fel na fydda i’n cael fy ngadael ar ôl
seeds.english: so that I don't get left behind
seeds.korean: 제가 뒤에 남겨지지 않도록

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n arfer byw yn yr ardal hon flynyddoedd yn ôl cyn i ni symud
seeds.english: I used to live around here years ago before we moved
seeds.korean: 저는 우리가 이사하기 전, 몇 년 전까지 이 지역에 살았었어요

seeds.welsh: wnaethon ni symud i’r ddinas
seeds.english: we moved to the city
seeds.korean: 우리는 도시로 이사했어요

seeds.welsh: does dim pwynt poeni am sut ti’n mynd i dalu
seeds.english: there's no point worrying about how you're going to pay
seeds.korean: 당신이 어떻게 돈을 낼지 걱정하는 건 소용없어요

seeds.welsh: clywes i bo’ ti’n mynd i dalu am wely newydd
seeds.english: I heard that you're going to pay for a new bed
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 새 침대 값을 낼 거라고 들었어요

seeds.welsh: mae hi wedi mynd i chwilio am rywle diogel i barcio’r car
seeds.english: she's gone to look for somewhere safe to park the car
seeds.korean: 그녀는 차를 주차할 안전한 곳을 찾으러 갔어요

seeds.welsh: cymerodd y newyddion rhai oriau i gyrraedd pawb yn y swyddfa
seeds.english: the news took several hours to reach everyone in the office
seeds.korean: 소식이 사무실에 있는 모든 사람에게 전해지는 데 몇 시간이 걸렸어요

seeds.welsh: fedri di ddal y drws ar agor tra dw i’n nôl y goriadau?
seeds.english: can you hold the door open while I fetch the keys?
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 열쇠를 가져오는 동안 문을 열린 채로 잡고 있을 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: mae’n brifo mwya’ pan dw i’n symud fy mhen i fyny ac i lawr
seeds.english: it hurts most when I move my head up and down
seeds.korean: 제가 머리를 위아래로 움직일 때 가장 아파요

seeds.welsh: wnes i ffeindio’r tŷ perffaith ar y diwrnod cynta’
seeds.english: I found the perfect house on the first day
seeds.korean: 저는 첫날에 완벽한 집을 찾아냈어요

seeds.welsh: ar ddiwrnod cynta’ y flwyddyn newydd
seeds.english: on the first day of the new year
seeds.korean: 새해 첫날에

seeds.welsh: daeth y ddau ar eu pennau eu hunain
seeds.english: they both came on their own
seeds.korean: 두 사람은 각자 혼자 왔어요

seeds.welsh: ond wnaethon nhw adael efo’i gilydd
seeds.english: but they left with each other
seeds.korean: 하지만 그들은 함께 떠났어요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i ddim yn medru dychmygu fy hun yn cael yn union yr un broblem
seeds.english: I couldn't imagine myself having exactly the same problem
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 정확히 같은 문제를 겪는 걸 상상할 수 없을 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i heb weld eu babi newydd hyd yn hyn
seeds.english: I haven't seen their new baby yet
seeds.korean: 저는 아직 그들의 새 아기를 못 봤어요

seeds.welsh: mi allai fo fod wedi digwydd i’r teulu cyfan
seeds.english: it might have happened to the whole family
seeds.korean: 그건 가족 전체에게 일어났을 수도 있어요

seeds.welsh: mae arna i ofn y byddi di’n anghofio pam oeddan ni angen aros yn fan hyn
seeds.english: I'm afraid that you'll forget why we needed to stay here
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 우리가 왜 여기에 머물 필요가 있었는지 잊어버릴까 봐 두려워요
seeds.note: mae arna i ofn (afraid that) = -ㄹ까 봐 두려워요, kept apart from poeni = 걱정하다

seeds.welsh: gadewch i ni gytuno fod o wedi bod yn ddwl deud y gwir
seeds.english: let's agree that it was stupid to tell the truth
seeds.korean: 우리 진실을 말한 건 어리석었다고 동의하기로 해요

seeds.welsh: yn hytrach na rhoi esgus
seeds.english: instead of giving an excuse
seeds.korean: 핑계를 대는 대신에

seeds.welsh: bydda i’n galw chdi nôl mewn tri neu bedwar munud
seeds.english: I'll call you back in three or four minutes
seeds.korean: 저는 삼사 분 후에 당신에게 다시 전화할 거예요
seeds.note: galw nôl and ffonio (294) both = 전화하다

seeds.welsh: i weld os byddi di wedi medru gorffen
seeds.english: to check if you've been able to finish
seeds.korean: 당신이 끝낼 수 있었는지 보려고
seeds.note: fragment; Welsh "i weld" = to see, English says "to check"; translated the Welsh

seeds.welsh: dw i’n cael hi’n anodd i gredu nad wyt ti’n medru dyfalu
seeds.english: I'm finding it hard to believe that you can't guess
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 추측하지 못한다는 게 믿기 어려워요

seeds.welsh: dyfala pwy ddudodd y stori ddoniol honno wrtha i
seeds.english: guess who told me that funny story
seeds.korean: 누가 저에게 그 웃긴 이야기를 해 줬는지 추측해 봐요
seeds.note: ti imperative = -아/어요 (here -아/어 봐요), no 당신 and no -시-; chi imperatives would take -(으)세요

seeds.welsh: mwy na thebyg dw i i fod i gadw’r pethau hynny mewn ystafell arall
seeds.english: I'm probably supposed to keep those things in another room
seeds.korean: 아마 저는 그 물건들을 다른 방에 보관하기로 되어 있을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fedrwch chi gyd roi eich dwylo i fyny?
seeds.english: can you all put your hands up?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 손을 들 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: fel medra i eu cyfrif nhw
seeds.english: so I can count them
seeds.korean: 제가 그것들을 셀 수 있도록

seeds.welsh: dydy o ddim yn wir bod unrhyw un yn medru ennill y gêm
seeds.english: it isn't true that anyone can win the game
seeds.korean: 누구나 경기를 이길 수 있다는 건 사실이 아니에요

seeds.welsh: oni bai bo’ nhw’n lwcus
seeds.english: unless they're lucky
seeds.korean: 그들이 운이 좋지 않은 한

seeds.welsh: fydd hi ddim yn gwrando ar bob gair ti’n ddeud
seeds.english: she won't listen to every word you say
seeds.korean: 그녀는 당신이 말하는 모든 말에 귀 기울이지 않을 거예요
seeds.note: gwrando = 귀 기울이다, kept apart from clywed = 듣다

seeds.welsh: gadewch i ni beidio mynd allan yn y tywydd ofnadwy yma
seeds.english: let's not go outside in this dreadful weather
seeds.korean: 우리 이 끔찍한 날씨에 나가지 않기로 해요

seeds.welsh: mi wnaeth o addewid na fyddai fo’n dewis y swydd anghywir
seeds.english: he made a promise that he wouldn't choose the wrong job
seeds.korean: 그는 잘못된 직업을 고르지 않겠다고 약속했어요

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n arfer meddwl bod bod yn wallgof yn ddrwg
seeds.english: I used to think that being crazy was bad
seeds.korean: 저는 예전에 미친 것이 나쁘다고 생각했어요

seeds.welsh: ond o’n i’n anghywir
seeds.english: but I was wrong
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 틀렸어요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim isio edrych fel bo’ fi ddim yn malio
seeds.english: I don't want to seem as though I don't care
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 신경 쓰지 않는 것처럼 보이고 싶지 않아요

seeds.welsh: ond mae hi’n mynd yn hwyr
seeds.english: but it's getting late
seeds.korean: 하지만 점점 늦어지고 있어요

seeds.welsh: does dim ots gen i os ti isio gadael heb y car
seeds.english: I don't mind if you want to leave without the car
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 차 없이 떠나고 싶어도 상관없어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n syniad da trio anadlu’n araf
seeds.english: it's a good idea to try and breathe slowly
seeds.korean: 천천히 숨 쉬려고 노력하는 게 좋은 아이디어예요

seeds.welsh: pryd bynnag ti’n teimlo’n flin
seeds.english: whenever you feel angry
seeds.korean: 당신이 화가 날 때마다

seeds.welsh: oedd hi’n iawn
seeds.english: she was right
seeds.korean: 그녀는 옳았어요

seeds.welsh: pwy bynnag ddudodd y byddai fo’n anodd oedd yn hollol iawn
seeds.english: whoever said it would be difficult was absolutely right
seeds.korean: 그게 어려울 거라고 말한 사람이 누구든 완전히 옳았어요

seeds.welsh: dy dro di ydy hi i fynd â’r dillad glân fyny grisiau
seeds.english: it's your turn to take the clean clothes upstairs
seeds.korean: 깨끗한 옷을 위층으로 가져가는 건 당신 차례예요

seeds.welsh: mae’r ci’n fudr ac yn wlyb
seeds.english: the dog is dirty and wet
seeds.korean: 개가 더럽고 젖어 있어요

seeds.welsh: achos mae o wedi bod yn chwarae yn y mwd
seeds.english: because he has been playing in the mud
seeds.korean: 왜냐하면 걔가 진흙에서 놀고 있었기 때문이에요
seeds.note: o for the dog = 걔 (그 for an animal reads as a man)

seeds.welsh: dw i’n teimlo’n drist ar hyn o bryd
seeds.english: I am feeling sad at the moment
seeds.korean: 저는 지금 이 순간 슬퍼요
seeds.note: ar hyn o bryd = 지금 이 순간 (see 40)

seeds.welsh: achos mae’n rhaid i mi fod yn ddistaw
seeds.english: because I have got to be quiet
seeds.korean: 왜냐하면 저는 조용히 있어야 하기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: pen y pentref
seeds.english: the end of the village
seeds.korean: 마을 끝

seeds.welsh: mae’r eglwys yn hyll
seeds.english: the church is ugly
seeds.korean: 교회가 흉해요

seeds.welsh: mae’r eglwys ym mhen arall y pentref yn hyll
seeds.english: the church at the other end of the village is ugly
seeds.korean: 마을 반대편 끝에 있는 교회는 흉해요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bod yr eglwys fach yn hyll iawn
seeds.english: I think the small church is very ugly
seeds.korean: 저는 작은 교회가 아주 흉하다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: dydy’r tywel ’ma ddim yn sych
seeds.english: this towel isn't dry
seeds.korean: 이 수건은 마르지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: a dw i wedi blino gormod i nôl un newydd
seeds.english: and I'm too tired to fetch a new one
seeds.korean: 그리고 저는 새것을 가져오기에는 너무 피곤해요

seeds.welsh: maen nhw’n chwarae cerddoriaeth yn hwyr yn y nos
seeds.english: they play music late at night
seeds.korean: 그들은 밤늦게 음악을 틀어요

seeds.welsh: ’swn i’n licio tasen nhw ddim yn chwarae cerddoriaeth mor uchel
seeds.english: I would like them not to play such loud music
seeds.korean: 저는 그들이 음악을 그렇게 크게 틀지 않으면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: mae hi mor hwyr yn y nos
seeds.english: it's so late at night
seeds.korean: 밤이 정말 늦었어요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti ’di ffeindio’r llwybr trwy’r coed?
seeds.english: have you found the path through the wood?
seeds.korean: 당신은 숲을 지나는 오솔길을 찾아냈나요?
seeds.note: llwybr = 오솔길, kept apart from ffordd

seeds.welsh: mae o’n mynd i lawr i’r traeth
seeds.english: it goes down to the beach
seeds.korean: 그건 해변으로 내려가요

seeds.welsh: does dim ots gen i os ydy o’n gar cyflym
seeds.english: I don't care if it's a fast car
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 빠른 차인지는 상관없어요

seeds.welsh: dw i jesd isio cyrraedd yno’n ddiogel
seeds.english: I just want to get there safely
seeds.korean: 저는 그냥 거기에 안전하게 도착하고 싶어요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i ddim wedi medru dal ati’n hirach
seeds.english: I wouldn't have been able to keep going any longer
seeds.korean: 저는 더 오래 버틸 수 없었을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i ddim wedi medru heb dy help di
seeds.english: I wouldn't have been able to without your help
seeds.korean: 저는 당신의 도움 없이는 할 수 없었을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i wedi meddwl amdano fo’n fwy gofalus
seeds.english: I'd have thought about it more carefully
seeds.korean: 저는 그것에 대해 더 신중하게 생각했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i wedi meddwl mwy tasai fo wedi bod yn fy newis i
seeds.english: I'd have thought more if it had been my choice
seeds.korean: 그게 제 선택이었다면 저는 더 많이 생각했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: mae hi wedi bod yn hyfryd treulio amser tu allan yn gwylio’r plant yn chwarae
seeds.english: it's been lovely spending time outdoors watching the children play
seeds.korean: 밖에서 아이들이 노는 것을 보면서 시간을 보내는 건 멋졌어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n disgwyl gweld gwelliant tro nesa’ byddwn ni’n cyfarfod
seeds.english: I'm expecting to see an improvement next time we meet
seeds.korean: 저는 다음번에 우리가 만날 때 나아진 걸 볼 거라고 예상해요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti ’di penderfynu faint ti’n fodlon talu?
seeds.english: have you decided how much you are willing to pay?
seeds.korean: 당신은 얼마를 낼 의향이 있는지 결정했나요?

seeds.welsh: faint wyt ti’n fodlon talu am dy docyn?
seeds.english: how much are you willing to pay for your ticket?
seeds.korean: 당신은 당신의 표에 얼마를 낼 의향이 있어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn argyhoeddedig y byddai hynna’n syniad da iawn
seeds.english: I'm not convinced that would be a very good idea
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 아주 좋은 아이디어일 거라는 게 납득이 되지 않아요
seeds.note: argyhoeddedig = 납득이 되다, kept apart from siŵr = 확신하다

seeds.welsh: wyt ti ’di anghofio be’ ddigwyddodd y tro diwetha’ wnaethon nhw ymweld â ni?
seeds.english: have you forgotten what happened the last time they visited us?
seeds.korean: 당신은 지난번에 그들이 우리를 방문했을 때 무슨 일이 있었는지 잊어버렸나요?

seeds.welsh: dyna’r math o beth sy’n gwneud y gwyliau’n arbennig iawn
seeds.english: it's the kind of thing that makes the holidays very special
seeds.korean: 그게 바로 휴가를 아주 특별하게 만드는 그런 거예요

seeds.welsh: mae’r gwyliau’n arbennig iawn i bawb
seeds.english: the holidays are very special for everyone
seeds.korean: 휴가는 모든 사람에게 아주 특별해요

seeds.welsh: mae wedi bod yn annifyr iawn
seeds.english: it's been upsetting
seeds.korean: 아주 속상했어요
seeds.note: Welsh has iawn (very); HC English "it's been upsetting" has no very. Translated the Welsh

seeds.welsh: mae o wedi bod yn annifyr iawn aros
seeds.english: it has been very upsetting waiting
seeds.korean: 기다리는 건 아주 속상했어요

seeds.welsh: dan ni wedi bod yn aros am y newyddion o’r ysbyty
seeds.english: we've been waiting for the news from the hospital
seeds.korean: 우리는 병원에서 오는 소식을 기다려 왔어요

seeds.welsh: rhywle cynhesach
seeds.english: somewhere warmer
seeds.korean: 더 따뜻한 곳

seeds.welsh: dan ni wedi trio’n aml
seeds.english: we've often tried
seeds.korean: 우리는 자주 노력해 봤어요

seeds.welsh: dan ni wedi bod isio mynd â’r plant i rywle bach yn gynhesach yn aml
seeds.english: we've often wanted to take the children somewhere a little warmer
seeds.korean: 우리는 자주 아이들을 조금 더 따뜻한 곳으로 데려가고 싶었어요
seeds.note: dan ni wedi bod isio (have wanted) = 싶었어요, same as oeddan ni isio

seeds.welsh: byddai fo’n licio gwybod bach mwy am sut beth ydy o
seeds.english: he'd like to know a little more about what it's like
seeds.korean: 그는 그게 어떤지 조금 더 알고 싶어할 거예요

seeds.welsh: sut beth ydy tyfu i fyny yma?
seeds.english: what's it like to grow up here?
seeds.korean: 여기서 자라는 건 어때요?

seeds.welsh: sut le ydy o yn y rhan yma o’r byd?
seeds.english: what's it like in this part of the world?
seeds.korean: 세계의 이 지역은 어떤 곳이에요?

seeds.welsh: sut beth ydy deffro bob bore a gweld y mynyddoedd?
seeds.english: what's it like to wake up every morning and see the mountains?
seeds.korean: 매일 아침 깨서 산을 보는 건 어때요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n medru gweld y mynyddoedd o ffenest fy stafell wely
seeds.english: I can see the mountains out of my bedroom window
seeds.korean: 저는 제 침실 창문으로 산을 볼 수 있어요

seeds.welsh: dw i isio ugain wy wedi’u berwi
seeds.english: I want twenty boiled eggs
seeds.korean: 저는 삶은 달걀 스무 개를 원해요

seeds.welsh: oedd hi’n arfer mynnu bo’ ni’n cael wyau i swper
seeds.english: she used to insist that we had eggs for supper
seeds.korean: 그녀는 예전에 우리가 저녁으로 달걀을 먹어야 한다고 고집했어요

seeds.welsh: felly o’n i isio tyfu i fyny a gadael cartref
seeds.english: so I wanted to grow up and leave home
seeds.korean: 그래서 저는 자라서 집을 떠나고 싶었어요

seeds.welsh: ddudodd hi wrthaf fi bod hi newydd weld y bws ola’
seeds.english: she told me she'd just seen the last bus
seeds.korean: 그녀는 저에게 그녀가 막 마지막 버스를 봤다고 말했어요

seeds.welsh: weles i’r bws ola’ yn gadael yr orsaf
seeds.english: I saw the last bus leaving the station
seeds.korean: 저는 마지막 버스가 정류장을 떠나는 걸 봤어요

seeds.welsh: wnaeth hi ddilyn fi i lawr i’r siopau
seeds.english: she followed me down to the shops
seeds.korean: 그녀는 가게들까지 저를 따라 내려왔어요

seeds.welsh: ac ar hyd y lôn fawr
seeds.english: and along the main road
seeds.korean: 그리고 큰길을 따라

seeds.welsh: faint bynnag o’n i’n dadlau oedd dal rhaid i mi rannu
seeds.english: however much I argued I still had to share
seeds.korean: 제가 아무리 다퉈도 저는 여전히 나눠야 했어요

seeds.welsh: oedd rhaid i mi rannu fy nheganau efo fy chwaer
seeds.english: I had to share my toys with my sister
seeds.korean: 저는 제 장난감을 제 자매와 나눠야 했어요

seeds.welsh: dw i angen gorwedd i lawr yn yr ardd
seeds.english: I need to lie down in the garden
seeds.korean: 저는 정원에 누울 필요가 있어요

seeds.welsh: a dw i angen cau fy llygaid am sbel
seeds.english: and I need to close my eyes for a while
seeds.korean: 그리고 저는 잠시 눈을 감을 필요가 있어요
seeds.note: am sbel = 잠시, am dipyn = 한동안

seeds.welsh: dw i’n amau fod o wedi clywed cant o straeon amdano fo
seeds.english: I suspect that he's heard a hundred stories about it
seeds.korean: 저는 그가 그것에 대해 백 가지 이야기를 들었을 거라고 짐작해요

seeds.welsh: mae o wedi clywed mil o straeon am be’ oeddan nhw’n gwneud
seeds.english: he's heard a thousand stories about what they were doing
seeds.korean: 그는 그들이 무엇을 하고 있었는지에 대해 천 가지 이야기를 들었어요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i wedi bod yn hapus i ddreifio ’set ti wedi deud wrthaf fi
seeds.english: I'd have been happy to drive if you'd told me
seeds.korean: 당신이 저에게 말했더라면 저는 기꺼이 운전했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i wedi dreifio ’set ti wedi deud wrthaf fi faint oeddat ti wedi blino
seeds.english: I'd have driven if you'd told me how tired you were
seeds.korean: 당신이 저에게 얼마나 피곤한지 말했더라면 저는 운전했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: oeddan ni’n siarad am sut wnaeth y cwbl ddechrau
seeds.english: we were talking about how it all started
seeds.korean: 우리는 그 모든 게 어떻게 시작됐는지에 대해 이야기하고 있었어요

seeds.welsh: sut wnaeth o ddechrau yn y lle cynta’
seeds.english: how it started in the first place
seeds.korean: 그게 애초에 어떻게 시작됐는지

seeds.welsh: doedd gynnon ni ddim nunlla i fyw ar y pryd
seeds.english: we didn't have anywhere to live at the time
seeds.korean: 당시에 우리는 살 곳이 아무 데도 없었어요
seeds.note: ar y pryd = 당시에, kept apart from bryd hynny = 그때 (606)

seeds.welsh: wnaeth hi gynnig gadael i ni aros efo hi
seeds.english: she offered to let us stay with her
seeds.korean: 그녀는 우리가 그녀와 함께 머물게 해 주겠다고 제안했어요

seeds.welsh: achos oeddan ni angen help
seeds.english: because we needed help
seeds.korean: 왜냐하면 우리는 도움이 필요했기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: ’swn i wedi gwybod bryd hynny be’ dw i’n gwybod rŵan fyswn i wedi aros
seeds.english: if I'd known then what I know now I'd have waited
seeds.korean: 제가 지금 아는 것을 그때 알았더라면 저는 기다렸을 거예요

seeds.welsh: ’swn i wedi gwybod fyswn i wedi gwneud pethau’n wahanol
seeds.english: if I'd known I'd have done things differently
seeds.korean: 제가 알았더라면 저는 일을 다르게 했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: byddai fo wedi bod y peth call i wneud
seeds.english: it would have been the sensible thing to do
seeds.korean: 그건 현명한 일이었을 거예요

seeds.welsh: y peth call i wneud fyddai wedi bod gofyn
seeds.english: the sensible thing to do would have been to ask
seeds.korean: 현명한 일은 물어보는 것이었을 거예요

seeds.welsh: mae o angen chwilio am waith
seeds.english: he needs to look for work
seeds.korean: 그는 일자리를 찾을 필요가 있어요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i wedi bod yn barod i edrych yn rhywle arall
seeds.english: I would have been ready to look somewhere else
seeds.korean: 저는 다른 곳을 둘러볼 준비가 되어 있었을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fysen ni wedi prynu rhywbeth
seeds.english: we would have bought something
seeds.korean: 우리는 뭔가를 샀을 거예요

seeds.welsh: mwy na thebyg fysen ni wedi prynu tŷ yno
seeds.english: we probably would have bought a house there
seeds.korean: 아마 우리는 거기에 집을 샀을 거예요

seeds.welsh: mae o’n agos at le mae dy deulu di’n byw
seeds.english: it's near where your family live
seeds.korean: 그건 당신의 가족이 사는 곳 가까이에 있어요

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n meddwl bo’ ti’n ddewr iawn i ddeud hynna
seeds.english: I thought you were very brave to say that
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 그걸 말하다니 아주 용감하다고 생각했어요

seeds.welsh: oeddat ti’n ddewr iawn i ddeud bo’ ti’n meddwl hynna
seeds.english: you were very brave to say you thought that
seeds.korean: 당신은 당신이 그렇게 생각한다고 말하다니 아주 용감했어요

seeds.welsh: oeddat ti’n meddwl fod o’n gamgymeriad
seeds.english: you thought that it was a mistake
seeds.korean: 당신은 그게 실수라고 생각했어요

seeds.welsh: dydy o ddim yn teimlo fel amser hir
seeds.english: it doesn't feel like a long time
seeds.korean: 긴 시간처럼 느껴지지 않아요

seeds.welsh: mae’n amser hir ers i ni weld ein gilydd
seeds.english: it's a long time since we saw each other
seeds.korean: 우리가 서로 본 지 오랜 시간이 됐어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n amser hir iawn ers i ni weld ein gilydd ddiwetha’
seeds.english: it's a very long time since we last saw each other
seeds.korean: 우리가 마지막으로 서로 본 지 아주 오랜 시간이 됐어요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i ddim wedi meiddio deud wrthi hi fod o wedi torri
seeds.english: I wouldn't have dared to tell her that it was broken
seeds.korean: 저는 감히 그녀에게 그게 깨졌다고 말하지 못했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n gwybod bod y plant wedi’i dorri fo
seeds.english: I knew that the children had broken it
seeds.korean: 저는 아이들이 그걸 깼다는 걸 알고 있었어요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti isio panad o goffi neu de?
seeds.english: do you want a cup of coffee or tea?
seeds.korean: 당신은 커피나 차 한 잔을 원하나요?

seeds.welsh: yndw, byddai hynna’n fendigedig, os gwelwch yn dda
seeds.english: yes, that would be great, please
seeds.korean: 네, 그거 근사할 거예요, 부탁해요
seeds.note: bendigedig = 근사하다 (English "great" is gwych elsewhere); os gwelwch yn dda is a chi form after a ti question, Welsh fixed phrase; 부탁해요 carries please

seeds.welsh: wyt ti isio rhywbeth i yfed?
seeds.english: do you want something to drink?
seeds.korean: 당신은 마실 것을 원하나요?

seeds.welsh: na, sgen i ddim syched, diolch
seeds.english: no, I'm not thirsty, thank you
seeds.korean: 아니요, 저는 목마르지 않아요, 감사해요

seeds.welsh: mae dy goffi di’n barod
seeds.english: your coffee is ready
seeds.korean: 당신의 커피가 준비됐어요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n licio te?
seeds.english: do you like tea?
seeds.korean: 당신은 차를 좋아하나요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n licio fo efo llefrith ond heb siwgr
seeds.english: I like it with milk but without sugar
seeds.korean: 저는 그걸 우유와 함께, 하지만 설탕 없이 좋아해요

seeds.welsh: ga i rywbeth i yfed, os gwelwch yn dda?
seeds.english: can I have something to drink please?
seeds.korean: 제가 마실 것을 받아도 될까요? 부탁해요

seeds.welsh: be’ fyddet ti’n licio?
seeds.english: what would you like?
seeds.korean: 당신은 뭘로 할래요?

seeds.welsh: gwydrad o ddŵr
seeds.english: a glass of water
seeds.korean: 물 한 잔

seeds.welsh: byddai gwydrad mawr o ddŵr yn iawn
seeds.english: a large glass of water would be fine
seeds.korean: 물 큰 잔으로 한 잔이면 괜찮을 거예요

seeds.welsh: liciwn i un o’r rheina
seeds.english: I'd like one of those
seeds.korean: 저는 그것들 중 하나면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: bag Siân ydy hwnna
seeds.english: that is Siân's bag
seeds.korean: 그건 샨의 가방이에요
seeds.note: Siân = 샨; the original 668 English had "Jane"

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl mai bag Siân ydy hwnna
seeds.english: I think that that is Siân's bag
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 샨의 가방이라고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: lle mae ei bag hi?
seeds.english: where is her bag?
seeds.korean: 그녀의 가방은 어디에 있어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n trio meddwl
seeds.english: I'm trying to think
seeds.korean: 저는 생각하려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, ga i eistedd efo chi?
seeds.english: excuse me, can I sit with you?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 제가 당신과 함께 앉아도 될까요?
seeds.note: formal chi to one person: marked by 실례지만 and by -(으)시- / 드리다 on the verbs that are about the listener (642-655). Here the verb is the speaker's, so only 실례지만 marks it. 당신 kept per the default; with -시- it reads oddly; 실례지만 (not 실례합니다, a 합니다-level formula)

seeds.welsh: yr un coch ydy o
seeds.english: it's the red one
seeds.korean: 그건 빨간 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl mai’r un coch ar y gadair yna ydy o
seeds.english: I think that it's the red one on that chair
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 그 의자 위에 있는 빨간 거라고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, sut dach chi’n teimlo?
seeds.english: excuse me, how do you feel?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 기분이 어떠세요?
seeds.note: formal chi = -(으)시-; 당신 + -시- is unnatural (natural: 실례지만, 기분이 어떠세요?)

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, dach chi isio?
seeds.english: excuse me, do you want?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 원하시나요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, fedrwch chi ddeud hynna?
seeds.english: excuse me, could you say that?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 그걸 말해 주실 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, mi fedra i helpu chi
seeds.english: excuse me, I can help you
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 제가 당신을 도와드릴 수 있어요

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, dach chi’n gwneud rhywbeth?
seeds.english: excuse me, are you doing something?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 뭔가를 하고 계시나요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, dach chi’n siarad Cymraeg?
seeds.english: excuse me, do you speak Welsh?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 웨일스어를 하시나요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, be’ ddudoch chi?
seeds.english: excuse me, what did you say?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 뭐라고 말하셨어요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, dach chi’n barod?
seeds.english: excuse me, are you ready?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 준비되셨나요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, dach chi isio mynd?
seeds.english: excuse me, do you want to go?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 가고 싶으신가요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, be’ dach chi’n meddwl?
seeds.english: excuse me, what do you think?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 어떻게 생각하세요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, be’ dach chi angen?
seeds.english: excuse me, what do you need?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 무엇이 필요하세요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, oes ots gynnoch chi?
seeds.english: excuse me, do you mind?
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 당신은 상관있으신가요?

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, dw i ddim yn siŵr os medra i helpu chi
seeds.english: excuse me, I'm not sure if I can help you
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 저는 제가 당신을 도와드릴 수 있을지 확실하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: esgusodwch fi, dw i’n meddwl bo’ chi’n gwneud yn dda iawn
seeds.english: excuse me, I think that you're doing very well
seeds.korean: 실례지만, 저는 당신이 아주 잘하고 계신다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: efo chi gyd
seeds.english: with you all
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두와 함께
seeds.note: fragment; chi gyd = 여러분 모두, plain 해요 (no -시-)

seeds.welsh: sut dach chi gyd yn teimlo?
seeds.english: how do you all feel?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 기분이 어때요?

seeds.welsh: dach chi gyd isio?
seeds.english: do you all want?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 원하나요?

seeds.welsh: fedrwch chi gyd ddeud hynna?
seeds.english: could you all say that?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 그걸 말할 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: mi fedra i helpu chi gyd
seeds.english: I can help you all
seeds.korean: 저는 여러분 모두를 도울 수 있어요

seeds.welsh: dach chi gyd yn gwneud rhywbeth
seeds.english: you're all doing something
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 뭔가를 하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dach chi gyd yn siarad hi
seeds.english: you all speak it
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 그걸 해요
seeds.note: hi = it (the language, feminine in Welsh); 그걸 해요 is vague Korean but has no other Welsh reading

seeds.welsh: be’ ddudoch chi gyd
seeds.english: what you all said
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두가 말한 것

seeds.welsh: dach chi gyd yn barod?
seeds.english: are you all ready?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 준비됐나요?

seeds.welsh: dach chi gyd isio mynd?
seeds.english: do you all want to go?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 가고 싶나요?

seeds.welsh: be’ dach chi gyd yn meddwl?
seeds.english: what do you all think?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 어떻게 생각해요?

seeds.welsh: oes ots gynnoch chi gyd?
seeds.english: do you all mind?
seeds.korean: 여러분 모두 상관있나요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n gobeithio y byddwch chi gyd yn medru mynd
seeds.english: I hope you'll all be able to go
seeds.korean: 저는 여러분 모두 갈 수 있기를 바라요
